episodes.title: Full Episode: Journalist Julie K. Brown on Covering the Epstein Case
episodes.description:
This week on Talking Central Florida, a conversation with the award-winning Miami Herald reporter Julie K. Brown.

Host Steve Mort talks with Brown about her extensive reporting on the sex trafficker Jeffrey Epstein, her ongoing coverage of the Epstein story, what survivors continue to tell her, and what she thinks future accountability might look like.

Julie Brown will join the Orlando Sentinel’s Scott Maxwell for a live conversation on October 7 at a First Amendment Foundation event in Winter Park.
